'''Khyyynett''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who attended the launch of a [[Gem of Alderaan|luxury hovertrain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. A group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Battle of the Gem of Alderaan|raided]] the [[Train/Legends|train]] and Khyyynett was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the attack.

==Biography==
Khyyynett was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]]<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> who played the [[Trumpet/Legends|clarion trumpet]]<ref name="Slughthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> and who had reached middle age by the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> Circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date and death" /> Khyyynett was among over one hundred guests from among the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] elite that were invited to the maiden journey of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] the ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The Wookiee attended launch gala held at a [[Train station/Legends|hoverstation]]<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]]<ref name="Primer">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/dodcampaign|text=''Dawn of Defiance'': Gamemaster Primer}}</ref> to open the event and then boarded the [[Train/Legends|train]] as it departed on a six [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] trip.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

{{RPG|''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]''}}
During the journey, accompanied by an entourage, Khyyynett visited the [[Decadence nightclub]] in the train's rear car. There, he had an altercation with his fellow guest [[Zalar Rishek]], an arrogant [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[House of Rishek]], while the pair's respective entourages watched on. However, the scuffle was quickly broken up by a group of undercover [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />
{{Endgame}}

A short [[Time/Legends|time]] later, the ''Gem of Alderaan'' was [[Battle of the Gem of Alderaan|raided]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who sought to capture Alderaan's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and incorrectly believed Organa to be traveling on the train.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> Khyyynett was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the mercenaries during the attack, thereby cutting short his musical career.<ref name="Slughthrowers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khyyynett appeared within ''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]'', a roleplaying module by [[Gary M. Sarli]] set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. The adventure was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[February 5]] [[2009]] as the eight instalment of [[Wizards of the Coast]]s' ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' roleplaying campaign. In the adventure, the player characters roleplay as agents of the Alderaanian Resistance who infiltrate the ''Gem of Alderaan'' and it is possible for the players to break up Khyyynett's tussle with Rishek. Alternatively, the players can be unsuccessful at separating the pair or to fail to intervene at all, in which case the disturbance escalates into brawl. Khyyynett was later mentioned in ''[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]], Part 2'', an article by [[Edward M. Erdelac]] published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[January 21]] [[2014]]. The article confirmed that the Wookiee musician was killed during an attack by Trandoshan mercenaries<ref name="Slughthrowers" /> depicted in ''The Gem of Alderaan''.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />
